# Reference Frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ReferenceFrame>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A reference system (such as a coordinate system, datum, grid, or platform space) relative to which locations, coordinates, or measurements are expressed.
